info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Redwood Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Redwood Drill Detail Catalog API enables users to efficiently manage and enhance their catalogs of redwood drill details. This API allows for the creation and submission of detailed specifications related to redwood drills, which can be critical for manufacturers, distributors, and retailers in the drilling industry. Typical consumers include product managers and inventory specialists who need to add or update product details to ensure accurate listings. By leveraging this API, businesses can improve their operational effectiveness and enhance customer experience through precise product information.

post.summary: Create new details for a Redwood drill.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details associated with a specific Redwood drill. By providing the necessary information, users can enhance the existing data structure and ensure accurate tracking and management of drill details.

requestBody.description: This request body expects details necessary for creating or updating information related to the redwood drill. Please ensure that the JSON structure adheres to the specified schema.

200.description: The request was completed successfully and the details are returned.

CreateCatalogRedwoodDrillDetailRequest.title: Redwood Drill Operation Request

redwood_drill_id.description: Unique identifier for the Redwood drill.

requestedBy.description: Name or identifier of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of the operation requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether this request should be prioritized.

unitPrice.description: The unit price for the operation requested.

CreateCatalogRedwoodDrillDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for operations related to Redwood drill.

CreateCatalogRedwoodDrillDetailResponse_.title: Operations Response Schema

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The unique identifier of the record that was processed.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when the processing was completed.

matchedCount.description: The number of records that matched the operation criteria.

CreateCatalogRedwoodDrillDetailResponse_.description: Response schema for the operations POST request, containing the status, record ID, processing time, and matched count.
